name: Pumps
description: Submersible, centrifugal, solar and diesel pumps selected for borehole supply, field irrigation and water transfer across a wide range of flow rates and heads.

name: Pipes
description: HDPE, PVC and layflat piping for conveying water from source to field, built to handle the pressures and conditions of agricultural use.

name: Fittings
description: Valves, couplings, adapters and connectors that join and control irrigation networks, from borehole head to the last sprinkler.

name: Sprinklers
description: Impact, micro and rotary sprinklers for even water application across field crops, orchards, lawns and pasture.

name: Irrigation Systems
description: Drip kits, center pivot components and controllers for building complete, efficient irrigation systems suited to the size of your operation.

name: Agricultural Equipment
description: Generators, water storage tanks and supporting equipment that keep pumping and irrigation infrastructure running reliably.
shortDescription: Additional equipment supporting modern agricultural operations.
